sources.notes: vidIQ returned 369.9K followers and 971 posts. The bio advertises A Cup of Zen and claims 100,000+ copies sold and Amazon bestseller status; these are seller assertions.

sources.title: Yangjun Instagram profile, via vidIQ
sources.source_type: connector readback of a first-party public profile
sources.notes: vidIQ returned 95.6K followers, 323 posts, an English wellness bio, and yangjunhealer.netlify.app. No creator statement establishing AI origin was found.

sources.title: The Zen Storyteller / A Cup of Zen
sources.source_type: first-party seller website
sources.notes: The English page offers a 21-story book: paperback $14.99, hardcover $19.99, Kindle $9.99 as displayed by the seller. It claims 100,000+ copies sold and a category bestseller rank. No order ledger or verified current Amazon rank was obtained.

sources.title: The Yangjun Method sales page
sources.source_type: first-party seller website
sources.notes: The English sales page displays a $29.99 one-time eight-week menopause digital guide and links to whop.com/yangjun/yangjun-menopause-guide. Its symptom, hormone, and efficacy claims were not independently verified.

sources.title: Yangjun's public Collabstr seller listing
sources.source_type: public creator marketplace self-description
sources.notes: The seller describes the monk as a wellness character, lists US-facing content, digital products and UGC services, and declares Pattaya, Thailand. This establishes positioning, not AI provenance or actual brand deals. The page's 0.0K audience placeholder is not treated as a zero-follower observation.

strategy_examples.observed_mechanism: Provider interview reports simple single-idea scripts and batch production for daily publishing. Public Shorts titles repeatedly use comment keywords to offer recipes.
strategy_examples.evidence_level: creator/provider case study plus public listing text
strategy_examples.metrics: First 20 listing entries: 12 to 2300 views at capture, compared with older documented high-reach Shorts. Recency windows and uploads were not fetched for this listing sample.
strategy_examples.adaptation_hypothesis: Use one original, non-medical reflection per video and an honest, product-relevant CTA; measure click-through and paid orders separately from views.

strategy_examples.observed_mechanism: A Zen story / life-dilemma caption connects a recurring storytelling identity to one named book and a direct checkout/Amazon link.
strategy_examples.evidence_level: caption, profile bio and first-party seller page
strategy_examples.metrics: 369.9K account followers; selected pinned Reel 2.8M indexed plays, 156196 likes and 16165 comments. Website sales counters are seller assertions.
strategy_examples.adaptation_hypothesis: Align original short parables, a free excerpt, and a tightly related book promise; compare post-to-product click and order conversion.

strategy_examples.observed_mechanism: The selected caption points to guide links in bio; one English seller page packages a narrowly positioned digital guide, while a separate public listing offers monk-character UGC services.
strategy_examples.evidence_level: caption, profile bio and seller pages
strategy_examples.metrics: 95.6K followers; selected recent Reel 2.1K indexed plays, 44 likes and 2 comments; guide displayed at $29.99. No order or conversion data.
strategy_examples.adaptation_hypothesis: Test one clearly defined audience problem and one relevant digital product; copy the funnel mechanism using substantiated product facts rather than the source's unverified health claims.

tool_inventory.name: vidIQ public research connector
tool_inventory.result: Public IG/TikTok discovery and four known-handle profile readbacks succeeded. Further credit-bearing calls were stopped when the connected plan returned insufficientCredits.
tool_inventory.credit_note: Actual _credits.used was not returned for successful calls; exact charges are unknown. Error responses explicitly say no credits charged.
limits: Indexed counts may be rounded or stale.
First-page recent/pinned reel samples are not complete histories.
Semantic discovery returned off-topic spirituality, real monks and non-monk avatars; explicit relevance filtering was necessary.
Profile presence is not AI-production disclosure or a revenue audit.

tool_inventory.name: yt-dlp
tool_inventory.result: Metadata-only extraction succeeded for one YouTube Shorts feed (20 entries), three Instagram Reels and one TikTok video. No video media downloaded.
tool_inventory.recommended_role: Public YouTube listing/video metadata, within platform access rules. Direct Instagram collection is not enabled after its robots notice review.
limits: Some Instagram fields such as duration/views returned null.
No video watch, transcript, sales or creator ownership proof.
Latest release differs from installed version; current installed version already satisfied the tested extraction.

tool_inventory.name: Instaloader
tool_inventory.role: Official project documentation describes Instagram profile/post/caption collection and incremental updates.
limits: Unofficial Instagram project.
Not installed or executed in this task.
The existence of an OSS extractor is not platform permission; not selected as an always-on collector.

tool_inventory.name: TikTok-Api
tool_inventory.role: Official project README documents an unofficial public data retrieval wrapper.
limits: Not installed or executed.
README requires Python 3.9+ and Playwright, describes site-change/bot-blocking failures, and excludes authenticated routes.
Retrieval only; it cannot publish content.
No proxy or access-control bypass was used.

tool_inventory.name: crwl / Crawl4AI
tool_inventory.result: Extracted current HeyGen case, creator sales pages, marketplace listing and external investigations. Instagram profile returned only a limited logged-out surface.
tool_inventory.role: Public creator-product and production-provider page evidence with a URL and capture date.
limits: A successful page fetch is not a paid order or identity verification.
Follow site access rules; direct Instagram crawling stopped after robots review.

tool_inventory.name: Scrapy + DuckDuckGo HTML
tool_inventory.result: Search results discovered creator product and X URLs. Exploratory Instagram Open Graph snapshots returned three known seed counts before the site rules review.
limits: A later broad search returned a challenge and was not bypassed.
Instagram explicitly disallows Scrapy; no subsequent direct collector was run.
Search snippets are discovery leads and were not elevated to verified post-body or accounting evidence.

tool_inventory.name: gh / GitHub API
tool_inventory.result: Read official repository metadata, READMEs and latest releases for yt-dlp, Instaloader and TikTok-Api.
limits: Repository availability and release freshness do not prove a crawler works on a target platform today.
